messages:
maya: flagging an odd one during compact-lite q4 bringup on staging — mixed CJK + Hebrew samples show punctuation mirroring and token insertion. quick notes:
- fp32 BLEU: 31.0, chrF: 56.7
- q8 BLEU: 30.8, chrF: 56.4
- q4 BLEU: 26.1, chrF: 51.2  (mixed-orientation subset)
- failing examples show parentheses/brackets mirrored and stray U+200C (ZWNJ) appearing in decode

maya: minimal example input:
```
（你好） — שלום [世界]
```

maya: fp32 output: "（你好） — שלום [世界]"  (consistent)
maya: q4 output: "）你好（ — שלום ]世界["  (closing/ opening parens swapped, odd control inserted)

cheng: odd. did the q4 job pick up the new "qcompress-v2" quant pipeline? last time we had locale churn when we changed NFKD -> NFKC ordering. i'll diff the normalization flags + tokenizer meta. @li-wei can you run sentencepiece vs tokenizers on this sample?

li-wei: running now. preliminary: sentencepiece roundtrips fine, but the huggingface tokenizers build we bundle with q4 runtime introduces an extra U+200C between RTL and LTR segments when ZWJ absent. gist with dumps: https://gist.github.com/li-wei/ef12ab34

nora: saw similar mirrored punctuation in a different bringup (aurora-lite) — in that case the runtime performed bidi reflow at decode stage because of an accidental post-process pass. are we applying bidi shaping twice?

sahil: the q4 container uses fused-concat + emit-compact kernels in the decoder. i can repro locally with --disable-emit-compact to see if it's kernel emit logic. running now with --dump-decoded-bytes and --tokens.

eval-bot: CI result -> https://ci.redwood/run/9123. Regression flagged: mixed-orientation/evalset-V3 delta BLEU -4.9. linked sample set at artifacts/9123/mixed-orientation-sample.jsonl

li-wei: token dumps from sentencepiece vs tokenizers below (short):
- sentencepiece tokens: ['\uff08', '你好', '\uff09', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u05e9\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd', ' ', '[', '世界', ']']
- tokenizers tokens (q4 runtime bundle): ['\uff08', '你好', '\uff09', ' ', '\u2014', ' ', '\u05e9', '\u200c', '\u05dc\u05d5\u05dd', ' ', '[', '\u200c', '世界', ']']
(note: inserted U+200C between hebrew graphemes and before CJK bracket)

sahil: kernel-disabled decode produces tokens matching fp32. with fused kernels enabled, additional soft-separator bytes appear in the decode buffer, which the postprocess interprets as ZWNJ. attaching velo trace to issue. probable off-by-one in buffer write when emitting multi-byte utf-8 across chunk boundary.

maya: action items: 1) @cheng diff normalization/tokenizer artifacts, 2) @li-wei run the repro across both tokenizers and attach compare script, 3) @sahil bisect fused-concat kernel (try v0/v1 toggle), 4) i'll create INF-1227 and pin failing artifacts + CI. if tokenization unaffected, we revert fused kernel in q4 canary.

cheng: pushed a small prototype that forces NFKC pre-tokenization and strips stray ZWJ/ZWNJ from token boundaries (branch: fix/norm-pretoken). PR #3467. can anyone validate quickly if that restores outputs for the repro set?

li-wei: validating PR now against gist. quick run: PR + tokenizers bundle -> output matches fp32 on the sample. will run the full mixed-orientation subset and post results.

nora: if PR fixes but we see perf hit, consider gating the normalization for languages with RTL-LTR joins only (config by locale).

sahil: confirming bisect: fused-concat v1 repros the issue; reverting to v0 in local container removes extra separators. opening a rollback patch for the q4 canary until we have root cause. sending patch link in INF-1227.

maya: thanks team. keep updates terse here. i'll summarize findings & mitigation in the issue and notify release/canary owners. :pray:
